comparison.objective: Remove an anti-theft hard tag from a garment using a magnetic detacher.
comparison.physical_skill: Precisely seat and hold the detacher while the other hand extracts the released pin.
comparison.success_condition: Clutch released before pulling, pin removed at least 15 mm, and tag, pin, and detacher released; early pulling fails.
comparison.reason: Tests conditional unlocking and pin extraction, not fracture initiation, impact regulation, or loose-fragment collection.
